_comment: windowed deduplicated Instagram reach. One doc per (profile, window): reach is IG's own range-deduplicated 'Accounts reached' total (metric_type=total_value), NOT a sum of daily rows. insight_window_start/end mirror the FB window contract that dedup_routing.available_windows reads. IG's API caps since..until at 30 days, so no window here ever spans more.
